title: Pieniadze to nie wszystko
outline: This movie is about the struggle of polish farmers who demonstrate against entering the European Union. They get support by a businessman who lost the sense of his life.It is very striking, many funny stereotypes and it's made funny (very funny having simple-minded farmers as potential audience) and with a certain social-critical note, but in the end there is a happy end.The overall quality is well too. Enjoyable film for the whole family if the plot sounds good to you.
